# Gradr

> AI-powered career command center: resume analysis, job matching, application generation, and interview coaching in one platform.

Gradr helps job seekers and professionals run their entire job search lifecycle through five AI engines — resume intelligence, job matching, application automation, interview coaching, and career growth.

## Pages

- [Home / Dashboard](/): Overview of pipeline, scores, and reminders.
- [Resume Engine](/resume): Upload and analyze resumes; AI scoring and rewrite suggestions.
- [Job Feed](/jobs): Personalized job recommendations and search.
- [Job Matching](/match): Score resumes against specific roles.
- [Pipeline](/pipeline): Drag-and-drop application tracker by stage.
- [Application Engine](/apply): Generate tailored cover letters and outreach.
- [Interview Engine](/interview): Real-time AI mock interviews with feedback.
- [Growth Engine](/growth): Skill gap analysis and career planning.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Subscription plans and pay-per-use features.
- [Settings](/settings): Account and profile preferences.

## Optional

- [Sign in](/auth): Account authentication.
